title: Warm Saudi Arabian Flatbread
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian flatbread recipe with a twist, made vegan for a modern twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal portions, depending on the desired size.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Brush the top with olive oil and cook for 1-2 minutes or until the bread starts to puff.
Flip the bread and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining dough portions.
